description: Single-concept XBRL time series for a ticker from SEC EDGAR XBRL companyconcept: every reported value of one concept (for example Revenues) with period end, value, form, filed date, accession and fiscal period. An unknown ticker or concept is refused free (400) before payment. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/screener/concept/{ticker}/{concept}.

units.description: Optional units; default is the concept's primary unit

name: screener_concept
